title: Inspector smoke payload — minimal valid input for the lean ★ elementor.schema.widget tool
_comment: WP-Q03 — Inspector smoke (14-fixtures-harness.md §8; 13-tool-catalog.md §5.2 #8, §1.1). schema.widget is READ-ONLY (readOnlyHint/idempotentHint; proxied-to-REST GET elementor-ultra/v1/schema/widget/{type}) — returns the POST-filter get_props_schema(). `e-atomic` widget schemas exist only when v4 atomic is active, so requires.experiments gates this on e_atomic_elements (a v4-disabled site SKIPS rather than erroring). MINIMAL valid input per §1.1: REQUIRED `type` (widgetType/elType); we probe `e-heading` (the canonical atomic widget used across the smoke trees). The §8 suite asserts no protocol error (-326xx) and a result matching the outputSchema {kind, schema, dynamic_props[], version}.
